system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Apple Intelligence has its own minimal default set because of its small context window. MCP tools are appended at runtime as `mcp_<server>_<tool>`
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt editable in Settings; Agent/Services/SystemPromptService.swift exists but not opened; composition inferred from per-provider tool sets and coding mode.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Reads codebases, edits files with precision, runs shell commands, builds Xcode projects, manages git
env_context_strategy.note: Repo-map JSONL indexing (ProjectIndexService) exists; whether injected by default unknown.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tier 1 = on-device Apple Intelligence summarization (free, private, no API tokens). Tier 2 = aggressive prune if Apple AI unavailable.
context_compaction.note: Full tool results spilled to disk and recoverable via restore_tool_result.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Take screenshots or paste images. Vision-capable AI models analyze what they see
observation_format.note: Auto-screenshots default OFF; accessibility tool returns element info.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: tool calls are reassembled and dispatched to Agent!'s tool runner

tool_count.note: README lists ~27 tools (done, list_tools, search, chat, memory, plan, goal_state, file, git, xcode, shell tiers, safari, spawn_agent...) but default per-provider filtering and AgentTools.swift not available.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit` = single-string replace. `diff_apply` = preferred for multi-line code edits
edit_primitive.note: file tool also has write/create; diff_apply semantics may not be unified diff exactly; CodexPatchApplier.swift exists.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: These are the canonical tool names defined in `AgentTools.Name.*` and exposed to every LLM provider via `AgentTools.tools(for:)`.
tool_schema_source.note: hand_written inferred; MCP tools appended at runtime.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Agent! supports [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers for extended capabilities.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: it observes the results, debugs errors, and iterates until the task is complete.
loop_primitives.note: Opt-in critic reviews diff before completion (CriticGate.swift).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Multi-plan CRUD with per-step status tracking

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only).
multi_agent_topology.note: spawn_agent listed among tools the LLM sees; default enablement not verified in code.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated sub-agent. 3 concurrent (up to 6 read-only). Optional model override + file-based results

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Mid-task user dialog (waits up to 5 min)
human_in_loop.note: ask_user is model-initiated; README mentions 'user approvals'; no per-call confirmation policy evidenced. Closest value.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Persistent goal + success criteria; marking done requires evidence

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Open `~/Documents/AgentScript/memory.md` in the system default editor

state_persistence.note: SessionStore.swift exists but not opened; README History re-runs prompts only.

self_verification.evidence_quote: an opt-in critic reviews the diff before completion
self_verification.note: Opt-in; goal_state evidence requirement; coding prefs auto-verify toggle.

retry_policy.note: Provider fallback chain is transport retry, not task retry.

rollback.note: rewind_task rolls back all touched files.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Signal task complete. Required at end of every task
termination_condition.note: max iterations in Agent Options; StuckGuard.swift may add stall detection (not opened).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Anthropic `cache_control` ephemeral + automatic prefix-cache hit tracking
cost_controls.note: Usage/cost tracking only; no budget cap evidenced.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell as current user via Launch Agent. Primary shell tool
execution_isolation.note: Root shell via Launch Daemon; in-process fallback.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Shell as ROOT via Launch Daemon. Admin tasks only — no sudo

permission_model.evidence_quote: Hard-blocks catastrophic commands (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~`, `dd` to `/dev/disk`, fork bombs, `--no-preserve-root`) before the Process is even constructed.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent! shows everything it does and logs every action.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Cannot be bypassed by the LLM.
guardrails.note: iMessage approved-sender filter is also an input gate.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Control any Mac app through the Accessibility API.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Powered by 21 LLM providers across local and cloud platforms.
